name: Controlled Threshold Touch
description: A 22-minute aerobic session including two short 1-minute threshold intervals to prime the legs without excessive fatigue.

coachCues.focus: Ride start: 2 interval blocks ahead; outline the session and how to warm up.
Effort 1 of 2 starts in 15 s: 1 min around 172 W (100% FTP). Prepare the rider and give one pacing cue.
Effort 2 of 2 starts in 15 s: 1 min around 172 W (100% FTP). Prepare the rider and give one pacing cue.
Cooldown starts: wrap up the session and tell the rider to spin easy.
